session_1.speaker: Alex
session_1.text: Maya, I'm moving to Portland in April for a new job at a coffee roastery.

session_1.speaker: Maya
session_1.text: Congrats! Portland sounds great. What roastery?

session_1.speaker: Alex
session_1.text: Stumptown. I start April 15th. They're giving me a $5k signing bonus.

session_1.speaker: Maya
session_1.text: Nice. My sister Tasha lives there, she can show you around.

session_2.speaker: Alex
session_2.text: First week at Stumptown is done. Met Tasha — she's awesome.

session_2.speaker: Maya
session_2.text: Told you! Have you found a place yet?

session_2.speaker: Alex
session_2.text: Yeah, a loft in Pearl District. $2,100/month. Steep but I love it.
